verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: [F] 100% of late trains were already late at Smith-9 Sts (inherited delay). Origins: at or before East Broadway: 302, at or before Bergen St: 8, at Jay St-MetroTech: 6, at or before Jay St-MetroTech: 3. Largest time loss on segment York St -> Jay St-MetroTech (median +48s vs schedule).
[F] 82% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Smith-9 Sts.
[G] 99% of late trains were already late at Smith-9 Sts (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Clinton-Washington Avs: 102, at Bergen St: 23, on approach from Smith-9 Sts: 2, at Fulton St: 2.
[G] 81% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Smith-9 Sts.
Weekend problem rate is 1.6x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
42% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 2.6x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 34% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.5x the system share) in the analysed months.
[G] Trains that would arrive at Carroll St within 180s behind a F train lose 192s more there than others (p=0.000; 47% of trips affected); 53% of problem arrivals at the target had such a conflict.
35% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 94%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
12% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 55% with an alert vs 32% without, lift 1.7x).
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 195s on average vs 103s otherwise (1.9x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at Carroll St, where F trains run ahead of G trains bound for 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on F, G during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Schedule rail-condition inspection / grinding on York St -> Jay St-MetroTech
recommendations.rationale: Track alerts (rail condition, track fire, debris) over-index at this location.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes speed restrictions and the associated run-time excess.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for F, G; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for F, G; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so F and G slots are offset by at least half a headway at Carroll St
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

recommendations.action: Coordinate planned track work windows to avoid the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Work windows overlapping busy hours amplify passenger impact.
